1036.description: A standing machine raise that lifts the leg forward to train the hip flexors and the front of the thigh.
instructions: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1100.description: A split squat with the rear foot in a strap. It builds the front leg and balance.
instructions: Put your rear foot in the strap and step forward.
Stand tall.
Lower your hips, back knee down.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Press up.
Switch legs.

1164.description: Calf raise under a Smith machine bar, working the calves with a fixed bar path for stable loading.
instructions: Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

1228.description: A standing dumbbell curl with the elbows turned slightly out to emphasise the inner head of the biceps.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, elbows slightly out from your sides.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower them slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

1292.description: A dumbbell fly on a stability ball with one leg lifted, which makes balance harder. It works the chest and trains core stability.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Place one foot on the ground and extend the other leg straight out in front of you.
Lean forward slightly and bring your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbells down and out to the sides, feeling a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将一只脚放在地面上，并将另一条腿伸直到您面前。
稍微向前倾，将手臂向两侧伸出，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃向两侧放低，感觉胸部有拉伸感。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1356.description: A one-arm high row on a lever machine. It works the upper back and lats and lets you train each side on its own.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the handle with one hand and keep your back straight.
Pull the handle towards your body, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
用一只手抓住手柄并保持背部挺直。
将手柄拉向身体，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1420.description: Start on your knees and explosively swing your arms to jump up onto your feet. It builds power in the glutes and hips.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your feet hip-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Hold a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your shoulders.
Engage your core and glutes, then explosively jump up into the air, extending your hips and knees.
As you jump, push through your toes and fully extend your ankles, knees, and hips.
Land softly back on the ground, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Immediately go into the next repetition, repeating the jump squat motion.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，双脚分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向前。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在肩膀上。
启动你的核心和臀部，然后爆发性地跳到空中，伸展你的臀部和膝盖。
跳跃时，用脚趾推动并充分伸展脚踝、膝盖和臀部。
轻轻地回到地面，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
立即进入下一个重复，重复跳蹲动作。

1484.description: A yoga pose on your belly where you lift legs and chest at once. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up.
Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Look slightly forward and keep your neck long.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.

1548.description: Using a chair for support, you extend one leg to stretch the thigh and hip. It loosens up the quads.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your quadriceps.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受股四头肌的拉伸。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

1612.description: A prone floor move where opposite arm and leg lift in alternation, training the back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Lift your chest slightly and brace your glutes.
Raise one arm and the opposite leg a few inches.
Switch sides in a controlled flutter.
Keep your neck neutral and breathe steadily.

1676.description: Alternating hammer curls while seated on an exercise ball. It trains the brachialis, biceps and core.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder while keeping your palm facing your body.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将一只哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持手掌朝向身体。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1740.description: A single-arm triceps extension performed bent over with the upper arm pinned to your side. Builds triceps strength and control.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend your arm straight back, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1804.description: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1868.description: Squat with the bar low on the back, taken from a rack, that works the glutes, thighs and back.
instructions: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.

1932.description: A partner guides your bent knee toward your chest to stretch the hips and glutes while you stay relaxed.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax.
Have a partner bring one knee slowly toward your chest.
Tell them to stop when you feel a stretch in the hip and buttock.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

2124.description: A kneeling side bend where you reach along the floor to stretch the side of the waist.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2188.description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2572.description: You roll back over your shoulders and then roll forward into a V sit, working the abs and building control.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and arms reaching forward.
Roll back, lifting your legs up and over toward your head.
Roll forward with control and extend your legs.
Land in a balanced V sit, with arms reaching toward your feet.
Move smoothly and use your abs to drive the motion.

2764.description: Bending the elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder, working the front of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2828.description: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.
instructions: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

2892.description: A beginner floor exercise crossing the legs like scissors to train the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

2956.description: A goblet split squat with the front foot on a raised platform. The extra height deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3084.description: A one-arm curl braced on a preacher pad for strict biceps isolation.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.

3212.description: A simple standing forward fold to reach your toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back and gets the hips moving.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with your hands, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3340.description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs holding dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

3404.description: Lift your arms out to the sides into a T shape to train the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with arms in front of you at chest height.
Open your arms out to the sides into a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

3468.description: A simple stretch for the back of the thigh.
instructions: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

3532.description: A light-footed shuffle used by boxers to keep the heart rate up.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

3660.description: Hold a face-down position to practice setting up for prone exercises.
instructions: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.

3724.description: A barbell press from the floor. The floor limits the range and takes pressure off your shoulders.
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a barbell set above your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up to full extension.

3788.description: A lunge that finishes with a high knee, combined with a one-arm band row. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3852.description: A plank where you lift one arm out to the side. It challenges your core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms and avoid twisting.

3916.description: A wall-supported handstand press between two benches for strong shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on two benches and kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Lower your head between the benches by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the movement controlled.
Come down carefully when done.

3980.description: A front raise done chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts without momentum.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest against the pad.

4044.description: One leg glute bridge where the free knee is hugged toward the chest. It strengthens the glutes and challenges hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat, the other knee pulled toward your chest.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4108.description: The rotating shoulder press popularized by Arnold, hitting all heads of the delts.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Fully extend your arms overhead.
Lower while rotating back to palms facing you.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching.

4172.description: A bent over fly using only your arms as resistance. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and arms hanging down.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

4236.description: A front raise with both arms while lying chest down on an incline bench. The support stops you from cheating with your back.
instructions: Set a bench to an incline and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height or just above.
Pause for a second.
Lower under control.
Keep your head neutral and your movement smooth.

4300.description: A standing stretch for the front of the thigh. Easy to do anywhere to ease tight quads.
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall or support for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab the ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping your knees together and hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

4364.description: A floor dip with one leg raised for extra challenge. It targets the triceps and core balance.
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and knees bent.
Lift your hips and extend one leg out.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Press back up.
Switch legs after your reps.

4428.description: A heavy sled push that builds leg drive and conditioning.
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles at chest or hip height.
Lean forward with a straight body line.
Drive through your legs with powerful steps.
Keep your core tight and push the sled forward.
Maintain a steady pace for the set distance.

4492.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the lower trapezius. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your lower trapezius while lying on your back on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4556.description: A quadruped drill that threads one arm under the body to free up the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Slide one arm under your body, palm up, reaching across.
Let your shoulder and head lower toward the floor.
Hold briefly, then pull the arm back.
Reach it up toward the ceiling, following with your eyes.
Repeat, then switch sides.

4620.description: A crunch with a rotation that adds work for the obliques on top of the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

4684.description: A kneeling upward press using a band. It targets the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and kneel facing away from it.
Hold the ends at chest height.
Press your hands up and forward at an incline.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

4748.description: A sit-up holding a dumbbell above your head, which lengthens the lever and makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Curl up to a seated position, keeping the dumbbell above you.
Keep your arms by your ears.
Lower back down slowly.

4812.description: A side crunch, a second variation, aimed at the obliques. It shortens the side of the waist with a small controlled movement.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Lower slowly without relaxing fully.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4876.description: Pressing your palms together in front of your chest. It activates the chest and shoulders without any equipment.
instructions: Stand or sit tall and press your palms together at chest height.
Point your fingers up and keep your elbows out.
Push your palms firmly into each other.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and shake out your arms.
Repeat for several rounds.

5004.description: A wide-stance squat holding suspension handles for support. It trains the inner thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand facing the anchor holding the handles with a wide stance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Sit your hips down, keeping knees over toes.
Use the straps lightly for balance.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

5068.description: Squeeze a weight plate between your palms and push it forward while on an incline. It hits the inner chest with a constant squeeze.
instructions: Set a bench to an incline and sit back with a weight plate held between your palms at chest height.
Squeeze the plate hard with both hands.
Push it straight out until your arms are extended.
Pull it back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your back against the pad and shoulders down.

5132.description: Small pulses while squeezing your shoulder blades together seated. It strengthens the upper back.
instructions: Sit tall with elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades together.
Pulse your elbows back in small movements.
Keep your shoulders down.
Maintain the squeeze throughout.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

5388.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the upper back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Kneel beside the roller and place one hand on it.
Place the roller under the upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Slide the roller forward as you rotate your chest open.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5516.description: Plate-loaded hack squat machine that lets you load the quads and glutes with back support.
instructions: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Do not lock your knees hard at the top.

5900.description: A deep lunge with a twist and the arms stretched wide. Builds leg strength and opens the spine.
instructions: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch sides.

6092.description: A plank with alternating knee drives to the elbow, building core strength.
instructions: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.

6156.description: A bent-over row using a kettlebell. It trains the lats and mid back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6220.description: A bodyweight row on suspension straps. It builds the back and biceps.
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

6540.description: A standing or seated rotation that opens the back and the side of the trunk. Good for easing stiffness through the spine.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

6796.description: A wide-stance squat on the smith machine down to a chair. The seat gives a consistent depth.
instructions: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up.

7564.description: Single-arm cable row in a split stance for stable pulling.
instructions: Stand in a split stance facing a low cable.
Grab the handle with one hand.
Row to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Keep your torso steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.

7884.description: A push-up with your hands on towels, adding instability for the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.

8076.description: A push-up with a weight plate on your upper back. The added load makes it harder once regular push-ups feel easy.
instructions: Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

8652.description: A seated drill where you tap each shoulder with the opposite hand, adding light coordination and shoulder work.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

9484.description: A combo that links a Romanian deadlift with a squat in one fluid rep. It works the hamstrings, glutes and quads together.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.

9612.description: Stepping across a box with dumbbells in your hands. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg.

9676.description: The classic lying leg curl on a machine, isolating the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

9868.description: A one-arm cable reverse fly, hinged at 45 degrees to target the rear delt.
instructions: Stand at a cable station and take one handle.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

9932.description: A bench press with resistance bands and plates added to the bar so the load gets heavier as you lock out. It builds chest and triceps strength through the top range.
instructions: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.

9996.description: A thumb hold against a band that builds strength in the muscles that extend the thumb. It is small and controlled.
instructions: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
Release slowly.
Repeat, then switch hands.

10188.description: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.

10764.description: A single-leg press-like squat on a sled while lying back. It builds leg strength with back support.
instructions: Lie back on the sled with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knee and lower the sled toward you.
Stop before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heel to extend the leg.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

11276.description: A lying face-down leg curl on a cable. Training one leg at a time builds the hamstrings evenly.
instructions: Lie face down with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

11788.description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the ulnar nerve on the inner side of the arm.
instructions: Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

0012.description: A lying leg raise where the legs lower to alternating sides, adding an oblique challenge to the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your abs and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
While keeping your legs together, lower them to one side until they are a few inches above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then lift your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
双腿并拢的同时，将它们降低到一侧，直到离地几英寸。
暂停片刻，然后抬起双腿回到起始位置。
到另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0076.description: A wide-grip bent-over row that emphasises the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将杠铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0140.description: A pull-up with an underhand grip. Targets the biceps.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull yourself up by bending your elbows, bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动核心肌群，弯曲肘部将自己拉起，使胸部靠近杠铃。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0204.description: A cable move where you drive the handle back behind you with the arms extended. It works the triceps and rear shoulders.
instructions: Attach a handle to a low pulley cable machine and stand facing away from the machine.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Keeping your elbows stationary, pull the handle back towards your body, squeezing your triceps at the end of the movement.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到低滑轮电缆机器上，并背对机器站立。
正手握住手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持肘部不动，将手柄拉回身体，在动作结束时挤压三头肌。
慢慢地将手柄返回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0268.description: A crunch combined with a leg lift so the lower abs work along with the upper. It is a compact full-abs move.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and your legs up.
Curl your shoulders off the floor while keeping your legs raised.
Squeeze your abs.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Lift your legs slightly higher at the top for extra work.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

0332.description: A dumbbell lateral raise to a T position, like an iron cross. It strengthens the delts and the upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, forming a T shape with your body.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
将双臂向两侧举起，直至与地面平行，与身体形成T字形。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0396.description: Seated, you raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height. It builds the side shoulders without leg drive.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows, until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将哑铃举至身体两侧，肘部稍微弯曲，直到手臂与地面平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0524.description: A kettlebell press that takes you from standing to leaning back while the bell stays overhead. It trains the shoulders, trunk and hips.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand.
Bend your knees slightly and press the kettlebell overhead with your right arm, keeping your elbow locked.
Rotate your torso to the left, shifting your weight onto your left foot.
Bend your left knee and lower your torso towards the ground, keeping your right arm extended overhead.
As you lower, keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your chest lifted.
Once your left hand touches the ground, push through your left foot and straighten your left leg, driving your hips forward.
As you drive your hips forward, use your core and right arm to press the kettlebell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住壶铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，用右臂将壶铃压过头顶，保持肘部锁定。
将躯干向左旋转，将重量转移到左脚上。
弯曲左膝，将躯干压向地面，保持右臂伸过头顶。
当你下降时，眼睛盯着壶铃，胸部抬起。
左手接触地面后，将左脚推入并伸直左腿，推动臀部向前。
当你向前推动臀部时，用你的核心和右臂将壶铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0588.description: Seated on a machine, you pull a narrow grip handle toward your torso. Trains the lats and mid back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to ensure proper form.
Sit on the machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with a narrow grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement.
Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度和脚踏板以确保形状正确。
坐在机器上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
紧紧握住手柄，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直并稍微向前倾斜。
将手柄拉向躯干，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢松开手柄并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0652.description: You hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin above it. A classic builder for the lats and upper back.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
弯曲肘部并将胸部拉向杠铃杆，将身体向上拉向杠铃杆。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0716.description: Tilting your head to one side, you add gentle pressure with your hand. Stretches the side of the neck.
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
Repeat the stretch 2-3 times on each side.
instructionsZh: 站直或坐直，肩膀放松。
将头向右倾斜，将右耳靠近右肩。
将右手放在头部左侧，轻轻施加压力以增加拉伸。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
在另一侧重复，将头向左倾斜并用左手施加压力。
每侧重复拉伸 2-3 次。

0844.description: A bent-over lateral raise with weights, lifting the arms out to the sides. It trains the rear and side delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Continue lifting your arms until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
继续举起手臂，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0908.description: A fly where your arms sweep upward from low to high. It targets the upper chest.
instructions: Anchor the band low and stand with a staggered stance.
Hold the ends with arms slightly bent.
Sweep your arms up and together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.

0972.description: A bicycle crunch with a band, rotating the torso and alternating the knees. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees bent.
Lift your feet off the ground and bring your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Straighten your right leg while bringing your left knee towards your chest and twisting your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Continue alternating the twisting motion, as if you are pedaling a bicycle, while keeping your core engaged throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双手放在脑后，膝盖弯曲。
将脚抬离地面，将右膝盖靠近胸部，同时扭转躯干，将左肘靠近右膝盖。
伸直右腿，同时将左膝靠近胸部，并扭转躯干，使右肘靠近左膝。
继续交替扭转运动，就像踩自行车一样，同时在整个运动过程中保持核心参与。
重复所需的重复次数。
